name: Builders' Mind
source:
Hiraya is about to graduate from engineering school.  She has to deal with a classmate who decided to confess to her, a father who is undergoing depression, as well as the final exams which are coming up.  But the biggest challenge would be discovering the true state of the world that she lives in.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241222155752/http://www.renai.us/game/bmind.shtml]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
Hiraya即将从工程学院毕业。她必须应对决定向自己告白的同学、正经历抑郁的父亲，以及即将到来的期末考试。然而最大的挑战，将是发现自己所生活世界的真实状态。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241222155752/http://www.renai.us/game/bmind.shtml]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
